floor_history.headline: recon: floor-3 candidate replayed on main; gap fully localized to first-p addu coalescing asymmetry

frontier.hypothesis: The first-p offset-temp fails to coalesce because prev_idx's use-site pseudo has a two-def phi live range interfering with the addu's dest with hard reg 2 (v0) — running an ALLOCDBG/-da greg dump from candidate baseline will name the pseudo, its class, and the conflict.
frontier.mechanism: Per [[register-alloc-pure-c]] Step-0: greg dump + global.c allocno priority tiebreaker; ledger names the two-def prev_idx / single-def next_idx asymmetry as prime suspect but never ran the -da probe. `Register dispositions:` will show whether the pseudo carrying (prev_idx<<16>>16<<2) conflicts with hard reg 2, and whether the addu's dest pseudo is joined to it.
frontier.next_probe: cpp src/text1b.c > tmp/grind/func_80057CC8/s1/base.i; cc1 <build-flags> -da tmp/grind/func_80057CC8/s1/base.i -o /tmp/ours.s; grep Register dispositions in text1b.c.greg for func_80057CC8; identify pseudo for (prev_idx<<16>>16<<2) source and pseudo for its addu dest; check conflict list and joined-pseudos

frontier.hypothesis: Branchless single-def prev_idx via cmov-style ternary `prev_idx = ((s16)((u16)(arg1-1)) < 0) ? arg0[3]-1 : (u16)(arg1-1);` collapses prev_idx to a single-def SSA-like live range matching next_idx's shape, allowing the same coalescing decision the second p gets.
frontier.mechanism: The 2026-06 rejected ternary form used an EXPLICIT `sidx` local (adds a def); a pure conditional-init ternary that binds directly to prev_idx has no extra local. GCC 2.7.2 cse/combine will fold the duplicated (arg1-1) computation; then RA sees prev_idx as single-def with the same coalescing opportunity as next_idx. NB: distinguish from disallowed dead-arm computation — both arms of the ternary have observable effect (produce the returned value), not a cheat.
frontier.next_probe: Draft the ternary form as tmp/grind/func_80057CC8/s1/probe_ternary_branchless.c; sandbox --disable all; if floor < 3 measure delta; if floor >= 3 objdump to confirm whether the coalescing changed or whether the ternary duplicated the (arg1-1) into a worse shape
